BiblicalUsage: Joshah is named once, in 1 Chronicles 4:34. In 1 Chronicles 4:34 we read, "And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,".
TheologicalSignificance: Joshah is part of the family history Scripture preserves, and I believe those lists are not filler.
